subject: its pointless nito
author: PsychedelicBabe
body:
🤓Nito it is pointless this guy is just well how can i put it nicely....''RETARDED''.....im sorry but c'mon to beg people for rank is one thing but to do it so consistently is just a violation.....i offered to help him on my PsychedelicBabe tag and he was like ''no your ok i need someone with a lower rank?''..wtf i was only ranked 300.....anyway then he sees me on my Swiftstyle tag.....well the guy nearly had a heart attack but the funny thing was he didnt want me to race him period.....he was expecting me to sit on the line and let him get free rank.....but 1 race wasnt all that he wanted.....noooo he wanted me to stay there until he got his rank down to between 50 and 75.....lmao i suppose if thats the only way hes going to get it then i wish him all the luck in the world.....but if hes so dead set on getting his rank down why doesnt he just learn/love and enjoy the game....and like i said previously what is he going to do with that nice low rank once he gets it { presuming he does }.....well nito i think if your up for a challenge then mr waxler would be the ideal contender.....hed certainly test your patience skills.....⭐

 

🌹....The only way to have a true friend...Is to be one....🌹

subject: mark waxler....
author: PsychedelicBabe
body:
😈 for a start you cant go for laps lol you have to sit on the line for the whole duration of the game....i actually feel kinda sorry for this guy hes getting an awful lot of stick of everyone me included but at the same time he actually does deserve it?.....is he for real though?.....or is he an attention seeker?.....tbh i dont think its down to the actual rank i think its more down to the fact that he thinks the lower your rank the better racers you race and the higher up the popularity ladder you go.....but what really really worries me is the fact that this guy cant even race/ he cant boost jump he cant boost drift or anything he is what wed call an ultimate scrub.....so why is he so desperate for rank?  what is he going to do with it once he gets it.....after all the messages hes sent out over the last 2 months as soon as he does get his rank down somebody is going to just take it of him anyway.....but i think theres more to it ive seen similar behaviour in small children who have ADHD....maybe thats what it is.....does anyone remember Undeadfire Zero? well when i first heard mark waxlers voice i was convinced they were the same people?....😲

 

🌹....The only way to have a true friend...Is to be one....🌹
